message.text:
The React frontend is embedded into the Go binary with `go:embed` and served as static files by the Echo web server.

`server/router/frontend/frontend.go` implements the serving logic. `server.go` wires it into the Echo router.

q27.
go:embed of `dist` served via Echo static + SPA fallback; server/router/frontend/frontend.go

The compiled React build is embedded with `//go:embed dist/*` and exposed through Echo `StaticWithConfig` plus `spaFallbackMiddleware` in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go`. `server/server.go` attaches that service with `frontend.NewFrontendService(...).Serve(...)`.
